_readme: Live settings, edit on GitHub to change behaviour without touching code (takes up to ~10 min to apply). bots.maxPerRoom: 0 turns fill-in racers off. busyRoomsHalf/busyRoomsOff: how many other busy public rooms before bots drop to 1 / 0. publicSlots: number of public quick-match rooms. peer: optional self-hosted PeerJS server, e.g. {"host": "peer.example.com", "port": 443, "path": "/", "secure": true} (also add it to the CSP in index.html).
